unresolved.title: Viridarium Chymicum
unresolved.author: Daniel Stolcius
unresolved.epithet: A pleasure-garden of one hundred and seven emblems
unresolved.summary: Stolcius's anthology reprints the finest emblems of Maier, Mylius and the Frankfurt printers as a single illustrated garden of the art, each plate under a Latin verse — the tradition's most compact picture-book.

unresolved.title: A Treatise of the Philosopher's Stone
unresolved.author: Bernard of Trevisan
unresolved.epithet: The nobleman who spent a fortune seeking the stone
unresolved.summary: The much-reprinted treatise ascribed to Bernard of Trevisan, whose famous parable of the fountain and the king's bath became one of alchemy's stock allegories of the work.

unresolved.title: Ripley Reviv'd
unresolved.author: Eirenaeus Philalethes
unresolved.epithet: A hidden adept's line-by-line reading of Ripley
unresolved.summary: Philalethes's commentaries on George Ripley's poems — the most influential English alchemy of the age, written by the pseudonymous adept whom Newton and Boyle both took with deadly seriousness.

unresolved.title: Aurora, or the Rising of the Sun (Paracelsus His Aurora)
unresolved.author: attributed to Paracelsus
unresolved.query: Paracelsus Aurora rising sun treasure treasures 1659
unresolved.epithet: The dawn of the treasure of treasures
unresolved.summary: The English 'Aurora' ascribed to Paracelsus, with the Treasure of Treasures — a visionary statement of the tincture and the universal medicine that shaped the Paracelsian revival in England.

unresolved.title: A New Light of Alchymie
unresolved.author: Michael Sendivogius
unresolved.query: New Light of Alchymie Sendivogius French 1650
unresolved.summary: The English New Light of Alchymie, carrying Sendivogius's doctrine of the hidden 'aerial nitre' that feeds all life — a book Newton read closely, bound here with a treatise of sulphur and the Dialogue of Mercury.
unresolved.imprint: London: Richard Cotes for Thomas Williams, 1650

unresolved.title: Idea Perfecta Philosophiae Hermeticae
unresolved.author: Jean Collesson
unresolved.epithet: A perfect idea of the Hermetic philosophy
unresolved.summary: Collesson's compact statement of Hermetic first principles and the single matter of the stone — a short, much-copied French adept's treatise of the mature tradition.

unresolved.title: Of the Nature of Things, Nine Books
unresolved.author: Paracelsus
unresolved.query: Paracelsus Of the Nature of Things Nine Books

unresolved.title: Opera Mineralia

unresolved.title: The Marrow of Alchemy

unresolved.summary: The long alchemical poem under the Philalethes name, setting out the theory and practice of the stone in verse — English adept-lore at the height of the Interregnum enthusiasm.

unresolved.title: The Hermetick Triumph

unresolved.author: Thomas Vaughan
unresolved.epithet: Vaughan on the light and the first matter
unresolved.summary: Vaughan's short Hermetic discourse on the 'house of light' and the universal spirit hidden in nature — the Welsh alchemist's mysticism of the world-soul.

unresolved.title: Euphrates, or the Waters of the East
